name: cloud.dchub/dc-hub
title: DC Hub — Data Center Intelligence
description: Live data-center, power & gas intelligence for AI agents — query it and cite it. 30 tools over Streamable HTTP: search 21,000+ facilities, score sites, rank 233 markets (DCPI power index), check the DCGI gas index, compare US ISO grids live, and pull interconnection queues, M&A, fiber, water & tax data. Free tier, no signup to start; responses are citation-ready (CC-BY-4.0).

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional. Free tier works with no key. A free email-verified dev key (https://dchub.cloud/signup) raises limits; paid/metered keys unlock the full Pro toolset.
